logline: 霧原不催你放下。它只是留出一點空。
youtubeTitle: [playlist] QuietLY · 霧原放下 — Slow Mandarin Jazz

comics.en: The plain does not hurry you to let go.
It only leaves a little room.
Hands, breath, and steps grow lighter.
comics.zh: 手、呼吸和腳步慢慢變輕。

comics.en: What you set down becomes the path.

tracks.lyrics:
[Instrumental intro — 35 seconds, no vocal]

[Verse 1]
我握太久
掌心有了自己的天氣
霧原沒有催我
只把草尖放低

[Instrumental interlude — 20 seconds, no vocal]

[Refrain]
手鬆開
霧就進來
不是失去
是空出一點地方

[Verse 2]
舊事像石子
從指縫落下
聲音很小
地面卻接得很穩

[Poetry]
移舟泊煙渚
日暮客愁新
野曠天低樹
江清月近人

[English — after poetry]
Let the hand open slowly
The field is not asking for proof
What falls can become quiet
What stays can breathe

[Instrumental break — 25 seconds, no vocal]

[Bridge — almost spoken]
放下不是命令
是手先累了
終於肯休息

[Final refrain]
掌心空了
霧更近了
我還在
卻輕一點

[Instrumental coda — 40 seconds, gradual fade, no vocal]

[Instrumental intro — 35 seconds, no vocal]

[English — opening]
No sign tells me where to go
The grass keeps the path open
I leave my name behind
And walk without an answer

[Instrumental — 10 seconds]

[Verse 1]
草徑沒有名字

[Instrumental interlude — 20 seconds, no vocal]

[Refrain]
無名就好
不用被記住

[Verse 2]
我曾替每件事命名

[Poetry]

[Instrumental break — 25 seconds, no vocal]

[Bridge — almost spoken]

腳知道方向

[Final refrain]
無名草徑
仍把我帶過

[Instrumental coda — 40 seconds, gradual fade, no vocal]

[Instrumental intro — 35 seconds, no vocal]

[Verse 1]
雨後的石

像終於不再反駁

[Instrumental interlude — 20 seconds, no vocal]

[Refrain]
讓它濕著

放下不是擦乾

[Verse 2]

[English — before poetry]
Before the poem, stay here:
a wet stone does not apologize
it holds the light

[Poetry]
獨憐幽草澗邊生

[Instrumental break — 25 seconds, no vocal]

[Bridge — almost spoken]

[Final refrain]
石還濕著
我也還在

把自己擦乾

[Instrumental coda — 40 seconds, gradual fade, no vocal]

[Instrumental intro — 35 seconds, no vocal]

[Verse 1]
雨打葉子

我不再把每一聲

[Instrumental interlude — 20 seconds, no vocal]

[Refrain]
低聲放下
不是投降
是把肩膀
還給自己的身體

[Verse 2]
路很泥

[Poetry]

何妨吟嘯且徐行

[Instrumental break — 25 seconds, no vocal]

[Soft jazz-rap — restrained, no trap]

[Instrumental intro — 35 seconds, no vocal]

[Verse 1]

[Male] 我帶著不甘
[Both] 霧原很寬

[Refrain]
各自飄過

放下不是

[Refrain — return]

把彼此抹掉

[Instrumental break — 25 seconds, no vocal]
